purpose: The old 50 same-sign pairs contain just four source-direction pairs that change the reference category. Form an additional noun-only counterfactual panel from permitted ordinary Validation. Retain the same relation sign, subject noun and qualifier; change only the landmark noun.
eligibility: Exclude 1204-panel physical scans by bytes. At least two subjects of the same class and four distinct annotated object identities. For each of two different reference categories, use the uniquely closest (or farthest) observed instance in camera depth with nonoverlapping depth extents to its same-class rivals, or its single visible instance. Both descriptions use exactly the same qualifier and side. Require unique, projected immediately adjacent subjects with the existing .015 normalized gap rules. Hash one pair per view then rotate recordings and prefer panel-unseen recordings. Up to 32 per target. Authored labels only for construction and post-seal scoring.
readout: Exactly the locked physical inventory and nine arms of the original study. Each source and sentence processed independently. Every selected pair reported. No source training, target labels for prediction, FINAL or per-pair configuration choices.
